Micron 7450 PRO 960GB NVMe M.2 Enterprise SSD (MTFDKBA960TFR-1BC15ABYYR)

The Micron 7450 PRO 960GB NVMe M.2 Enterprise SSD is a high-performance enterprise storage solution designed for modern data centers, cloud infrastructure, and business-critical workloads. Built on the PCIe Gen4 NVMe interface, this SSD delivers low latency, dependable responsiveness, and enterprise-class reliability for servers requiring consistent storage performance.

Designed in the compact M.2 2280 form factor, the drive fits space-constrained server platforms while providing excellent scalability. Moreover, the Micron 7450 PRO series is optimized for mixed-use enterprise applications, making it suitable for virtualization, cloud computing, database management, boot drives, edge computing, and content delivery environments. As a result, organizations can deploy reliable storage without sacrificing valuable server space.

Security is another major advantage of the Micron 7450 PRO 960GB NVMe M.2 Enterprise SSD. It supports TCG Opal hardware-based encryption to help protect sensitive business data while simplifying security management. In addition, enterprise-grade firmware and advanced reliability features help maintain consistent operation across demanding workloads, reducing downtime and supporting long-term operational efficiency.

The Micron 7450 PRO family is engineered to provide balanced performance, power efficiency, and endurance for enterprise deployments. Whether upgrading existing servers or building new infrastructure, this SSD offers dependable performance for continuous business operations. Furthermore, its enterprise-focused design helps maximize storage efficiency while maintaining predictable performance under sustained workloads.

Key Specifications

  • Manufacturer: Micron
  • Model: MTFDKBA960TFR-1BC15ABYYR
  • Product Series: Micron 7450 PRO NVMe Enterprise SSD
  • Capacity: 960GB
  • Interface: NVMe PCIe Gen4

  • Warranty: 3-Year Official Warranty

The Micron 7450 PRO 960GB NVMe M.2 Enterprise SSD is an excellent choice for organizations seeking secure, efficient, and enterprise-grade storage for demanding server environments. Its combination of PCIe Gen4 performance, compact M.2 design, and TCG Opal security makes it ideal for modern data center deployments.
